title: 奥恩·亮彩手绘 Sketch
description: 巨大深色卷角与浓密红胡须相映，宽阔口鼻保留公羊般外形。

art_direction.medium: bright colored-pencil sketch, confident graphite contours, visible cross-hatching and selective gouache on pale drawing paper
art_direction.identity: Ornn is a stocky ramlike god with immense curled dark horns, a dense red beard, a broad muzzle, and heavy blacksmith gauntlets. He wears a full leather apron over opaque wool garments and boots; his large forge hammer has a broad metal head and a clearly visible wooden grip.
art_direction.scene: An expansive horizontal arrangement inside the square for the complete character silhouette, concentrated facial drawing and loose peripheral marks. Build the composition around this champion's defining anatomy and core motif. Only a few light environment marks; keep the picture predominantly bright and colorful.
art_direction.palette: ember amber, lilac pencil shadow, iron gray, beard red, blue; high-value vivid local color, luminous warm-white paper, bright chromatic shadows, limited canonical dark details
art_direction.weapon_policy: iconic static prop, no attacks or firing

visual_qa.method: Compressed JPEG contact sheet, max edge 1280 and under 350 KB
